mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (user_id, title, content, type, is_read, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{isRead}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, type, is_read, create_time, update_time FROM message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, title, content, type, is_read, create_time, update_time FROM message WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE message SET is_read = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE message SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
